mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_categories AS ( SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id = #{categoryId} AND visible = 1 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM categories child JOIN visible_categories parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.visible = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.name, b.logo_media_id AS logoMediaId FROM visible_categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.enabled = 1 JOIN product_brands pb ON pb.product_id = p.id JOIN brands b ON b.id = pb.brand_id ORDER BY b.id
